questions: What is a reservation?
If the reservation is cancelled, is the whole arrangement cancelled too?
What is a forum?
If the forum shuts down, can the dispute still be heard?
Where is the seat?
If the seat changes, must every part of the process move too?
What does ratification do?
If ratification is missing, can the agreement still take effect?
What does a signature mean?
If the signature is withdrawn, is the promise automatically over?
What is a charge?
If the charge runs out, does it need replacing?
What is execution?
If execution fails, does the decision stop counting?
What is an award?
If the award is set aside, does the winner lose everything?
What is a blockade?
If the blockade is broken, does everything get through at once?
What is a protocol?
If the protocol is dropped, do the parties stop communicating?
What is asylum?
If asylum is refused, must the person go back where they came from?
What is accession?
After accession, does the new member get the same rights as everyone else?
What is exhaustion?
When exhaustion is reached, is there nothing left to do?
What is necessity?
If necessity ends, is everything back to normal?
What is passage?
If passage is suspended, can anyone still go through?
